SF001.message: Cannot deref a Box inside a reducer; read it in a handler (enter, exit, update, transition or commit) or an observer.
SF001.cause: A reducer called deref() on a Box. Reducers are pure, and a Box holds a live resource.
SF001.fix: Read the Box in a handler or an observer; give the reducer what it needs as payload or props.

SF002.message: Items of <definition>: a map takes with(key, item)
SF002.cause: with() on Items that are a map got one argument.
SF002.fix: Call with(key, item) on a map of items.

SF003.message: Items of <definition>: a keyed set takes with(item) and keys it itself
SF003.cause: with() on Items that are a keyed set got a key as well as the item.
SF003.fix: Call with(item); the set's key function gives the key.

SF004.message: Items of <definition> take its instances only, not <value>
SF004.cause: with() got a value that is not an instance of the definition the Items were made of.
SF004.fix: Pass an instance of that definition, made by one of its variants.

SF005.message: FrozenSet is immutable; build a new FrozenSet instead of mutating.
SF005.cause: add, delete or clear was called on a FrozenSet held in state props.
SF005.fix: Build a new FrozenSet with the change and return it in the next props.

SF006.message: FrozenMap is immutable; build a new FrozenMap instead of mutating.
SF006.cause: set, delete or clear was called on a FrozenMap held in state props.
SF006.fix: Build a new FrozenMap with the change and return it in the next props.

SF007.cause: A flow call got an object applyFlow never ran on.
SF007.fix: Call applyFlow(target, states, initializer) on the object before using it.

SF008.cause: A call reached a flow after disposeFlow: an Error from dispatch, lock or a read, a Rejected result from the send of a lock taken before.
SF008.fix: Stop using the object after disposeFlow; make a new one.

SF009.cause: The states given to applyFlow hold something that is not a state definition.
SF009.fix: List only definitions made by defineState()...build().

SF010.cause: The object given to applyFlow has no property named after one of its states.
SF010.fix: Give the object a property with the state's name holding its initial props.

SF011.message: <path> starts in a transitional variant, which commits only as the temp of a declared transition
SF011.cause: The initial instance, or the one FlowConfig.start gives, holds a variant marked transitional.
SF011.fix: Start in a variant that is not transitional.

SF012.message: <path> starts in <variant>, whose entry is asynchronous; declare a transition into it
SF012.cause: A nested state of the initial instance would enter a variant marked async, which only a declared transition enters.
SF012.fix: Start in a synchronous variant and enter this one with StateResult.transition.

SF013.message: <flow> has no emit method, which defineEvent("<event>") needs
SF013.cause: The initializer defined an event on an object that has no emit method.
SF013.fix: Give the object an emit(name, payload) method, or drop the event.

SF014.message: <state> and <state> both declare a result named <name>; every state with a result reducer of that name takes it, so one state of a flow declares it
SF014.cause: Two state definitions of one flow declare a named result of the same name.
SF014.fix: Rename one of the results, or declare it on one state only.

SF015.message: Cannot dispatch from inside a reducer
SF015.cause: A reducer called dispatch or a lock's send. Reducers are pure.
SF015.fix: Return the change from the reducer; send from a handler or from outside the flow.

SF016.message: Cannot dispatch to <flow> from inside its own dispatch
SF016.cause: A handler, observer or tap sent to the object whose step is running.
SF016.fix: Return a named result from the handler, or send after the dispatch returns.

SF017.message: nothing to abort: no transition is pending and the lock is held
SF017.cause: A Rejected result: an abort was sent while no transition was pending and another caller held the lock.
SF017.fix: Expect it when an abort may race a transition's end; otherwise send without abort.

SF018.message: Lock is held. Use `await using send = await lock(target)` for queued access
SF018.cause: dispatch was called while another caller held the object's lock.
SF018.fix: Take the lock with await lock(target) and send through it.

SF019.message: A transition is pending on <flow>; use lock() to queue, or { abort: true }
SF019.cause: dispatch was called while a declared transition's work was running.
SF019.fix: Send through lock() to queue behind it, or send with { abort: true } to end it.

SF020.cause: A lock's send was called after the lock was released.
SF020.fix: Send only inside the lock's scope; take a new lock for a later operation.

SF021.message: <path> would be left in <variant>, a transitional variant, which commits only as the temp of a declared transition
SF021.cause: A reducer's next leaves a node in a variant marked transitional.
SF021.fix: Return that variant as the temp of StateResult.transition, or another variant as next.

SF022.message: <path>: its failed <instance> would leave <path> in a transitional variant
SF022.cause: The failed a reducer declared would leave a node in a variant marked transitional.
SF022.fix: Declare a failed that holds no transitional variant.

SF023.message: <path> replaced or removed <path>, whose own reducer also answered
SF023.cause: A reducer replaced or removed a nested state whose own reducer answered the same signal, so two answers would decide it.
SF023.fix: Keep the nested state in the parent's answer, or let only one of the two reducers answer.

SF024.message: <path> enters <variant>, whose entry is asynchronous; declare a transition
SF024.cause: A reducer's next enters a variant marked async without declaring a transition.
SF024.fix: Return StateResult.transition(next, temp, failed) to enter it.

SF025.message: <path> enters <variant>, whose entry is asynchronous, <where>; declare a transition
SF025.cause: A failed step or a transition's failed end would enter a variant marked async.
SF025.fix: Declare a failed whose variants are synchronous.

SF026.message: <place> holds <box> <where>, which the temp drops from <place>; the temp's commit disposes it
SF026.cause: An end of a transition holds a DisposableBox the temp leaves out, and the temp's commit disposes it.
SF026.fix: Keep the box in the temp too, or give the end a new box.

SF027.message: <place> and <place> hold <box> <where>; a DisposableBox has one place in the states
SF027.cause: One DisposableBox stands in two places of the states a step would commit.
SF027.fix: Keep each DisposableBox in one prop; move it rather than copy it.

SF028.message: <place> holds <box> <where>, which the engine disposed already
SF028.cause: A step would commit a DisposableBox the engine disposed when a state dropped it.
SF028.fix: Make a new box for the resource instead of reusing the disposed one.

SF029.cause: A handler of the failed step, or a result reducer folding into it, refused. A failed step commits whatever its handlers answer, so the refusal is an Error of the result.
SF029.fix: Make the failed variant's handlers succeed; report trouble there through state, not a refusal.

SF030.message: <where> answered for <path>, which this step changes already; two answers would decide one state
SF030.cause: A result reducer of another state answered for a node the step changes already.
SF030.fix: Let one of the two decide that node: drop the result reducer's change or the step's.

SF031.message: <where> answered for a node the transition of <path> decides at its next or failed; two answers would decide one state
SF031.cause: A result reducer answered for a node that a pending transition's next or failed decides.
SF031.fix: Fold the result into the transition's next and failed, or into a node outside them.

SF032.message: <where> would leave <path> in a transitional variant, which commits only as the temp of a declared transition
SF032.cause: A result reducer's answer leaves a node in a variant marked transitional.
SF032.fix: Return a variant that is not transitional from the result reducer.

SF033.message: <where>: <path> enters <variant>, whose entry is asynchronous; declare a transition
SF033.cause: A result reducer's answer enters a variant marked async, which only a declared transition enters.
SF033.fix: Enter that variant through a signal reducer that returns StateResult.transition.

SF034.message: failed: <the refusal that ended the transition>
SF034.cause: The reason of a transition's AbortSignal (TransitionAborted of kind failed): a handler refused, or the end step did not commit.
SF034.fix: Read the refusal in the message; stop the work and release what it acquired.

SF035.cause: A transition's work outlasted its timeoutMs (TransitionAborted of kind timeout); the failed end committed.
SF035.fix: Make the work answer sooner or raise timeoutMs; release what it acquired on abort.

SF036.message: an abort of <path> is already in progress
SF036.cause: A Rejected result: an abort was sent while another abort of the same transition was waiting for its work.
SF036.fix: Send one abort per transition and wait for its result.

SF037.cause: A Rejected result: an abort's reducers ignored it or changed nothing, so the transition goes on.
SF037.fix: Give the abort signal a reducer on the transition's temp that changes the state.

SF038.message: <the abort reducer's refusal>; the transition continues
SF038.cause: A Rejected result: a reducer rejected the abort signal, so the transition goes on.
SF038.fix: Expect it where the abort may be refused, or let the reducer accept the abort.

SF039.message: <the abort reducer's error>; the transition continues
SF039.cause: A reducer of the abort signal threw or broke a rule, so the transition goes on. The reducer's error is its cause.
SF039.fix: Fix the reducer's error named in the message.

SF040.cause: An abort was accepted: the transition's AbortSignal reason (TransitionAborted of kind aborted), and the Rejected outcome of the aborted send.
SF040.fix: Stop the work on abort and release what it acquired; expect Rejected where an abort may come.

SF041.message: flow disposed during the abort of <path>
SF041.cause: disposeFlow ran while an accepted abort waited for its work.
SF041.fix: Expect it when the object may be disposed during an abort.

SF042.message: Cannot dispose a flow from inside a reducer
SF042.cause: A reducer called disposeFlow. Reducers are pure.
SF042.fix: Dispose from a handler or from outside the flow.

SF043.message: Cannot dispose <flow> from inside its own dispatch
SF043.cause: A handler of a running step called disposeFlow on its own object.

SF044.message: flow disposed during the transition of <path> to <variant>
SF044.cause: disposeFlow ran while a declared transition was pending; the transition's result is this Error.
SF044.fix: Expect it when the object may be disposed during a transition.

SF045.cause: disposeFlow ran while a send waited in the queue behind a transition.
SF045.fix: Expect it when the object may be disposed while sends are queued.

SF046.cause: The reason of a transition's AbortSignal (TransitionAborted of kind disposed) when disposeFlow ran during its work.
SF046.fix: Stop the work on abort and release what it acquired.

SF047.message: <variant>: mockHandlers mocks enter, exit, update, transition and commit handlers, not <key>
SF047.cause: mockHandlers got a key that is not a handler kind.
SF047.fix: Use only the keys enter, exit, update, transition and commit.

SF048.message: <variant>: its <kind> handlers are mocked already; dispose that mock first
SF048.cause: mockHandlers mocked a kind of a variant that a live mock covers already.
SF048.fix: Dispose the first mock (using mocks = ...) before mocking again.

SF049.message: <variant> is not asynchronous: only a variant declared with { async: true } has transition handlers
SF049.cause: A transition handler was registered or mocked on a variant not marked async.
SF049.fix: Declare the variant with { async: true }, or use an enter handler.

SF050.message: Handler '<handler>' returned a promise; enter, exit and update handlers are synchronous
SF050.cause: An enter, exit or update handler is async or returned a promise.
SF050.fix: Return a HandlerResult synchronously; put the waiting in a transition handler.

SF051.message: exit handler '<handler>' returned the named result <name>; only an enter, update or transition handler may
SF051.cause: An exit handler returned a named result; the node it leaves holds no instance to fold it into.
SF051.fix: Return the named result from an enter, update or transition handler.

SF052.cause: A transition handler returned a value that is not a promise.
SF052.fix: Make the transition handler async, or return a promise of its HandlerResult.

SF053.message: Handler '<handler>' did not return a HandlerResult
SF053.cause: A handler returned, or its promise resolved to, something other than a HandlerResult.
SF053.fix: Return HandlerResult.ok(), a refusal, an error, or a named result of the variant.

SF054.cause: A handler returned a named result of another variant than the one it was registered on.
SF054.fix: Return a named result of the handler's own variant.

SF055.message: two transitions declared in one dispatch: <path> and <path>
SF055.cause: Two reducers answered one signal with StateResult.transition; an object has one pending transition.
SF055.fix: Declare the transition in one reducer; let the other answer with next.

SF056.message: <where> returned a transition or a failed; it answers with next only
SF056.cause: A result reducer of another state returned StateResult.transition or a failed.
SF056.fix: Return the next instance or props only from a result reducer.

SF057.message: <where> returned <instance>, whose key <key> is not its own
SF057.cause: A reducer of an element of a keyed set returned an instance whose key differs from the element's.
SF057.fix: Keep the props the key is made of; add a new element to change the key.

SF058.cause: A reducer's ctx.read named a state the flow does not hold.
SF058.fix: Read a state the flow was applied with, by its name.

SF059.message: <where> returned a promise; reducers are synchronous
SF059.cause: A signal or result reducer is async or returned a promise.
SF059.fix: Return the next state synchronously; put the waiting in a transition handler.

SF060.message: <where> returned no StateResult, instance or props
SF060.cause: A signal reducer returned something other than a StateResult, an instance or props.
SF060.fix: Return a StateResult, an instance of the state, or its props.

SF061.cause: A reducer returned an instance of another state definition than its own.
SF061.fix: Return an instance of the reducer's own state, made by one of its variants.

SF062.cause: A named result reached a variant that declares no result reducer of that name.
SF062.fix: Add the result reducer to the variant's defineFlow, or return the result from the variant that has it.

SF063.message: <where> changed a nested state; nested states change only through a step
SF063.cause: A result reducer returned props whose nested states differ from the ones it got.
SF063.fix: Keep the nested states as they are; change them with a signal their own reducers take.

SF064.cause: An Ignored result: no variant the states are in has a reducer for the signal.
SF064.fix: Add a reducer for the signal to the variant, or expect Ignored where it is not handled.

SF065.message: Result is abstract: a reducer returns a StateResult, a handler a HandlerResult
SF065.fix: Use StateResult in a reducer and HandlerResult in a handler.

SF066.message: <the result expect() refused: its signal, handler, kind, state, and error or message>
SF066.cause: expect() got a result of a kind it was not given. The result's error, when it has one, is its cause.
SF066.fix: Handle the outcome the message names, or list its kind in expect().

SF067.message: a pending or declared transition result cannot be merged or copied
SF067.cause: merge was called on an InTransition result.
SF067.fix: Await done() and merge its outcome.

SF068.message: StateResult.ok takes a state instance; a reducer returns props bare
SF068.cause: StateResult.ok got props or another value, not an instance.
SF068.fix: Pass an instance (variant(props)), or return the props bare.

SF069.message: StateResult.ok: failed must be an instance of next's state
SF069.cause: The failed given to StateResult.ok is not an instance of next's definition.
SF069.fix: Pass a failed made by a variant of next's state.

SF070.message: StateResult.transition takes a state instance as next; a reducer returns props bare
SF070.cause: StateResult.transition got props or another value as next.

SF071.message: StateResult.transition takes a state instance as temp, the instance the node holds while the work runs
SF071.cause: StateResult.transition got no instance as temp.
SF071.fix: Pass the instance the node holds during the work as temp.

SF072.message: StateResult.transition takes failed, an instance of next's state, which the node takes when the work fails
SF072.cause: StateResult.transition got no instance as failed.
SF072.fix: Pass the instance the node takes when the work fails as failed.

SF073.message: StateResult.transition: next, temp and failed must be instances of one state definition
SF073.cause: next, temp and failed of StateResult.transition are of different definitions.
SF073.fix: Make next, temp and failed with variants of the reducer's own state.

SF074.message: StateResult.transition: the options are an object { timeoutMs }
SF074.cause: The options of StateResult.transition are not an object.
SF074.fix: Pass { timeoutMs } or leave the options out.

SF075.message: StateResult.transition: the options take timeoutMs only, not <key>
SF075.cause: The options of StateResult.transition have a key other than timeoutMs.

SF076.message: StateResult.transition: timeoutMs must be a positive finite number <= <max>, got <value>
SF076.cause: timeoutMs is not a positive finite number up to the largest delay setTimeout honours.
SF076.fix: Pass a timeoutMs above 0 and at most 2147483647.

SF078.message: State prop `<key>` holds a non-plain class instance `<class>`; wrap live resources in `Box(...)` or expose frozen plain data.
SF078.cause: A state's props hold a Set, a Map, or an unfrozen instance of a class.
SF078.fix: Wrap a live resource in Box(...); use FrozenSet, FrozenMap or frozen plain data for data.

SF079.message: State prop `<key>` holds <value> inside its data; a nested state goes directly in a prop, as an instance or in Items (def.items()).
SF079.cause: A state instance or Items sits inside an array, object or collection in a prop, where its handlers would never run.
SF079.fix: Put the nested state directly in a prop, alone or in def.items().

SF080.cause: A value that is not a state instance was given where one is needed.
SF080.fix: Pass a state instance, made by a variant.

SF081.cause: A state definition has no variant marked { initial: true }, and no start was given for it.
SF081.fix: Mark one variant { initial: true }, or give the state in FlowConfig.start.

SF082.message: <variant>: the parser returned something other than a plain object (prototype Object.prototype or null); the engine copies props without a constructor when it rebuilds a node
SF082.cause: A state's parser returned a class instance or another non-plain value.
SF082.fix: Return a plain object from the parser.

SF083.cause: A state definition was called on a value that is no snapshot or ctx holding that state.
SF083.fix: Call the definition on a snapshot of the flow or on a reducer's ctx.

SF084.cause: The snapshot holds no instance of this definition under its name (another definition may share the name).
SF084.fix: Read a state the flow was applied with.

SF085.message: Only one initial state variant is allowed
SF085.cause: A second variant of one state was marked { initial: true }.

SF086.message: <variant>: an initial variant cannot be transitional
SF086.cause: A variant was marked both initial and transitional.
SF086.fix: Drop one of the two marks.

SF087.message: <variant>: an initial variant cannot be asynchronous
SF087.cause: A variant was marked both initial and async.
SF087.fix: Start in a synchronous variant and enter this one with a transition.

SF088.message: <variant>: a transitional variant cannot be asynchronous
SF088.cause: A variant was marked both transitional and async.
SF088.fix: Drop one of the two marks.

SF089.cause: build() was called on a state with no .name().

SF090.cause: build() was called on a state with no .variant().
SF090.fix: Declare at least one variant, one of them initial.

SF091.message: <name>: a variant cannot be named items, which is the definition's items() method
SF091.cause: A variant was named items, the name of the definition's own method.

SF092.message: <name>: the signal <signal> is listed under the key <key>; a reducer keyed <key> would never run
SF092.cause: A key of the object given to .signals() is not the name of the signal under it.
SF092.fix: List each signal under the name given to its defineSignal(name).

SF093.cause: defineFlow ran twice for one variant.
SF093.fix: Call defineFlow once per variant, with all its reducers.
